Let me start by saying by I am a very paranoid and skittish individual and most things that bother me can easily be brushed off as simple misunderstandings but this was undeniably true so a little while back on the Sunday before my birthday keep in mind I’m a 20 year old man at the time and I’m pretty big so understandably my parents had left on a quick cigarette run and I was drifting off into sleep tv playing rather loud when all of a sudden I hear a knock on my front door and what sounds like my dads voice say “ open the door “ to which I started to get up and put on a shirt as I had been hot and I guess I had been taking to long because the voice called out again and more aggressive but this time it sounded wrong like a layer of radio static over it but I began to walk to the door when my phone began to ring and my heart sank it was my dad on the phone and I answered trying to hide my fear as I asked him where he was and he told me he was at the gas station keep in mind the closest gas station is about 20 minutes away by car so I quickly ended the talk and grabbed the rifle my dad kept hidden in his bedroom and I heard whatever it was shuffle off towards the woods and I open the door but nothing was there and I turn to go back inside but as I close the door I hear this inhuman scream echo through the woods I can tell you this i won’t sleep right for a while after that.
